domains.source: frozen ORION exact quantum/combinatorial task family

task_eligibility: A task must have a pre-existing failure/negative artifact before selection and an objective verifier that can accept or reject a proposed recovery. Freeze all task IDs and parent negative artifacts before any arm operates.
budget_matching: Each non-oracle arm receives identical visible task state, negative history, verifier access limit, wall-independent step budget, and maximum verifier-call count per task. Exact numeric budgets must be frozen in the task manifest before execution.
reporting: Preserve donor wins, failed recoveries, unresolved tasks and CANNOT_CHECK; report per-domain as well as pooled outcomes.
stop_rule: No replacing failed tasks, expanding budgets, or changing what counts as recovery after protected outcomes.
